description: Full-text search regulator guidance (soft law) served by stella: methodologies, opinions, guidelines, recommendations, FAQs and similar documents, never court decisions. Every result names its issuer, document kind, publisher URL and required attribution. Filter by authority, jurisdiction, kind and issue date; paginate with limit and cursor. A source served as metadata only is matched on its title alone, so a missing hit there says nothing about its text. Totals are not counted.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
